completed_steps.summary: Loaded documentation requirements CSV (12 project types) and selected exhaustive scan
Confirmed multi-part monorepo with backend (project_type_id=backend), frontend (mobile), infrastructure (infra)
Inventoried existing docs: 4 part READMEs, OpenAPI spec, descriptions, release evidence/validation, BMAD planning artifacts; user requested full coverage
Captured tech stacks: Node 20 + Express 5 + Mongoose 8 backend; Expo 55 + RN 0.83 frontend; Pulumi 3.203 infrastructure
Read every backend service src exhaustively; mapped routes, models, publishers, support-failure logger; produced api-contracts-backend.md and data-models-backend.md
Generated annotated source-tree-analysis.md covering backend, frontend, infrastructure, CI workflows, scripts, and maestro flows

Wrote development-guide-backend.md, development-guide-frontend.md, development-guide-infrastructure.md, and deployment-guide.md from package manifests, README, docker-compose, SAM, Pulumi, Fastlane, and CI workflows
Documented integration architecture: HTTP routes, WebSocket envelope, SNS/Redis fanout, room-history log gating, infrastructure stack discovery
Wrote part-specific architecture documents for backend, frontend, infrastructure with executive summary, stack table, patterns, source tree, and known constraints
Validated all generated docs; no _(To be generated)_ markers; existing release-readiness, openapi, and BMAD artifacts cross-linked

findings.project_classification: Multi-part TypeScript monorepo with three coordinated parts (backend microservices, Expo Router frontend, Pulumi infrastructure)

technology_stack.backend: Node.js 20 + TypeScript 5.9 (strict false) + Express 5 + Mongoose 8 + MongoDB 7 + AWS SAM + SNS + Redis (local) + ws + @aws-sdk v3
technology_stack.frontend: Expo 55 + Expo Router 55 + React 19.2 + React Native 0.83.2 + TanStack Query 5 + Zod 4 + AsyncStorage + reanimated 4 + Vitest 4 + Maestro + Fastlane
technology_stack.infrastructure: Pulumi 3.203 + @pulumi/aws 7.10 + ACM (us-east-1) + CloudFront with OAC + S3 (private) + Route 53

scan_notes: Exhaustive scan read every backend service src/*.ts and frontend route, hook, component, util, config, and constant.

OpenAPI under docs/openapi/ was subsequently expanded to cover every shipped REST endpoint plus the WebSocket connect at /ws (with x-protocol: websocket and the seven character_*/battle_* event schemas listed under serverToClient).
v2.0.0 removed the gateway service; the current tree reflects Nginx-as-edge.
Class/race/gender are stored as JSON-encoded strings (legacy shape); frontend parseArrayField handles legacy comma-separated fallback.

resume_instructions: Workflow complete. Re-run for an updated scan.
